$comment: Generated by video/audio/compose.mjs. Do not edit by hand; change score.mjs and re-run. Times in seconds, frames at 60 fps (frame = round(t * 60)).
grid: beat k at k * 0.5 s, 16th n at n * 0.125 s, bar b at b * 2 s; every bar starts on an even second

hook.note: the hook is the four column pitches

sections.sound: hats on 16ths, a tick per hairline, the hook on the cursor; no kick
kick enters on 2.0; split-flap density doubles per split
glitch bed, off-grid hats, pips, reversed swell; hard cut at 5.5 with one dry stamp
four-on-the-floor; each tile landing is a pluck pitched by its column
a stamp per milestone, a paper swish per PR card
riser over 4 beats, filtered kick pump, 2 frames of silence before 14.0
Merge click: sub drop, kick, click transient, Am9 stab; groove returns
light stamps on the recap, heavy stamp on RELEASED, decoder ticks
dot-matrix 16ths, heavy stamp on 20.0, schema decode
rising plucks per merged block, hollow thock for the rejected one, pull-back sweep
kick drops out; flap rattle and denied buzz, click-lock on 24.5
a kick per word, snare roll and reverse cymbal into 27.0
kick and sub on 27.0, a click per mark cell, stamp on 27.5, groove filters out, one hat on 29.5

silences.note: everything but the dry stamp (5.5) and the un-sort swell (5.6 -> 6.0) is cut

hits.name: cell.fill
hits.note: one cell fills ink, cursor appears

hits.name: pickup.start
hits.note: the cell starts to tremble before the first split

hits.name: cut.silence
hits.note: everything stops except the dry stamp

hits.name: unsort.start
hits.note: reversed noise swell starts, streaks pull back up

hits.name: unsort.lock
hits.note: every streak back in its tile

hits.name: pan.timeline
hits.note: orthographic pan right, red playhead starts

hits.name: riser.peak
hits.note: riser stops dead; 2 frames of silence follow

hits.name: flash.ink
hits.note: one ink frame, one signal-red frame

hits.name: merge.click
hits.note: biggest hit in the track: sub, kick, click

hits.name: text.paid-only-when
hits.text: Paid only when a human merges.
hits.note: the whole line lands on the first frame after the flash

hits.name: text.human
hits.note: 'human' punches in signal red on the backbeat

hits.name: state.released
hits.note: RELEASED fills green; dot travels the path

hits.name: pad.dominant
hits.note: E chord holds under 202 until the recap

hits.name: text.202-accepted
hits.note: 'Payment Required' strikes through; the task is held until an admin approves

hits.name: endcard.impact
hits.note: the mark opens at full size

hits.name: text.promise
hits.text: The inbox for your AI coding agents. Your agents get paid only when you merge.

hits.name: smallprint.fade
hits.note: testnet disclosure fades up and holds

hits.name: bookend.blink
hits.note: red centre cell blinks off just before and is back on with the tick; last sound in the film

sidechain.note: 0 open .. 1 fully ducked; drive the Archivo width axis with it

energy.note: per-frame RMS of the master, normalised to 0..1
